steps.detail: Send a clear written demand to the seller by email or message enclosing your UPI receipt and chat proofs, asking for a full refund of Rs 1200 due to non-delivery and failure to cancel.

steps.title: File a formal consumer complaint online
steps.detail: If the seller fails to refund your money, file an online consumer complaint on the official e-Jagriti portal by uploading your UPI receipt and chat screenshots.

draft_document.text:
To,
[SELLER/COMPANY NAME]
[SELLER ADDRESS OR SUPPORT EMAIL]

SUBJECT: DEMAND FOR REFUND OF RS 1200 FOR NON-DELIVERY OF DRESS

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am a consumer who purchased a dress from your website on 28 October 2026 for an amount of Rs 1200, paid via UPI under transaction reference [INSERT UPI REF / TRANSACTION ID].

To date, you have neither shipped the item nor processed my cancellation request, despite multiple follow-ups via chat support where false shipping dates were provided. As the occasion for which the dress was purchased has already passed, the consideration for this contract has failed.

Therefore, I hereby call upon you to refund the full amount of Rs 1200 to my UPI account within 7 days of receiving this notice. Failing this, I shall be forced to initiate formal proceedings against your business on the e-Jagriti portal and through the National Consumer Helpline for deficiency in service and unfair trade practices.

Sincerely,

[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR CONTACT NUMBER]
[YOUR EMAIL ADDRESS]
[DATE]
